title: AOS must record time stamps for audit records that can be mapped to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) or Greenwich Mean Time (GMT).
check_content:
Verify the AOS configuration with the following command: 
show clock 
 
If the clock is not set to the appropriate time zone or UTC/GMT, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure AOS with the following commands: 
configure terminal 
clock timezone <IANA time zone> 
to set the appropriate timezone 
write memory
VulnDiscussion: Alerts provide organizations with urgent messages. Real-time alerts provide these messages immediately (i.e., the time from event detection to alert occurs in seconds or less).
